claim_boundary: Exactly one future audit may test whether a conservatively lagged monthly improvement in the University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index supports a full-capital BTC-or-cash policy. The survey measures household sentiment, not crypto demand or alpha.

feature_contract.publisher: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

prior_matrix.identity: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment UMCSENT
prior_matrix.finding: FRED identifies UMCSENT as a monthly, not-seasonally-adjusted University of Michigan index, states that the data are delayed by one month, requires citation and warns that graph data are subject to revision.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A delayed present-vintage monthly index is not original release-vintage evidence and a month-over-month rise need not predict BTC.

prior_matrix.identity: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers
prior_matrix.finding: The publisher reports an Index of Consumer Sentiment together with current-conditions and expectations components and publishes preliminary and final monthly releases.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The frozen family uses only the headline final monthly FRED series and may not switch to a component, preliminary reading or surprise after outcome access.

prior_matrix.identity: Closed STLFSI4 below-normal stress long-cash family
prior_matrix.finding: The market-stress composite was closed before BTC outcomes because Validation had only two high-stress weeks.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: UMCSENT is a lower-frequency household survey change, not a threshold rename or rescue of STLFSI4, VIX or NFCI.

future_design_requirements: Before BTC outcome access, freeze one exact no-credential FRED UMCSENT request contract, raw response and a 2017-2024 monthly subset with date, value, timing, revision and citation boundaries.

Use only the strict adjacent-month increase relation, first day of the second following calendar month at 00:00 UTC and one-calendar-month validity; no level threshold, moving average, percentile, alternate lag, component or surprise.
Require both rising and non-rising states with sufficient transitions in Design and Validation before direct economics.

Run deterministic matched-capital BTC versus zero-yield-cash Design and Validation economics under normal and doubled adverse friction with total, realized and unrealized return, drawdown, Calmar, upside, holding, terminal inventory, annual breadth and concentration gates.
Treat present-vintage history as historical research only. A pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED until separately sealed independent OOS succeeds.
uncertainty: UMCSENT is revised and FRED exposes a delayed present-vintage history rather than the exact value available at each historical decision time.
Consumer sentiment can react to inflation and politics without transmitting to crypto liquidity or risk appetite.
Monthly switching may be too slow for BTC drawdowns and may create opportunity cost during rapid recoveries.
The series is copyrighted with citation required; raw and normalized data must remain internal research inputs unless separate reuse rights are verified.
No 2017-2024 UMCSENT value, state count, BTC outcome, strategy path, hypothesis, candidate, post-2024 observation or OOS was accessed while freezing this prior.
